documentation.description:
-
  @summary
  Thin, SPARK-friendly helpers for character and string I/O on a GNAT.Serial_Communications port.

  @description
  Provides simple conversion functions between Stream_Element / Stream_Element_Array and Character / String together
  with the classic Get / Put / Get_Line / Put_Line operations. The package is intended for console-style protocols
  used by classic and modern retro calculators (SwissMicros DM-series, HP-IL emulators, etc.).

tagged_types.name: Serial_Port
tagged_types.code: type Serial_Port is new GNAT.Serial_Communications.Serial_Port with null record;

subprograms.name: Expect

documentation.description:
-
  Read from the serial port until the expected string is found, capturing any preceding characters.

  Characters preceding the Expected sequence are stored in Text. The Expected sequence itself is consumed but not
  stored in Text. If the preceding text would exceed Text'Length, Data_Error is raised.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description:
used only on the exceptional path

The open serial port.

parameters.name: Expected
parameters.description:
used only on the exceptional path

The string sequence to wait for.
: @param     Text     Buffer that receives the characters preceding Expected.
: @param     Last     Index of the last character stored in Text (Text'First - 1 if none preceded).

parameters.name: Max_Characters
parameters.description: used only on the exceptional path

exceptions.name: GNAT
exceptions.description: .Serial_Communications.Serial_Error Raised on timeout or I/O error.

exceptions.name: Data_Error
exceptions.description: Raised when the preceding text exceeds Text'Length.
